report_topic: Efficacy of implementation of the Constitution (Seventy-fourth Amendment) Act, 1992
observations_summary: The audit found that the State Government retained overriding powers over Urban Local Bodies (ULBs), hindering their autonomy and effective devolution of functions as mandated by the 74th CAA. This resulted in significant financial shortfalls, poor revenue collection, staff shortages, and delays in elections and committee formations, undermining the ULBs' ability to function as self-governing institutions.
